input.title: CSV ledger aggregation pattern
input.content: Task pattern: "total amount of sales rows in ledger.csv export". ALWAYS read export.json first — parser params are NOT always the defaults. Observed variants: {"encoding":"utf-16","delimiter":"\t","preamble_lines":2} vs utf-8/comma/0. Pass encoding, delimiter, skip_lines from export.json to parse_csv. ledger.csv columns = category,amount; rows alternate sales/refund. "total amount of sales rows" = SUM(amount) for category=="sales" (a sum, NOT a row count). Example with utf-16/tab/2 preamble: sales rows 13,31,49,67 -> 160 (4 rows). read_file returns only hex prefix + byte size for utf-16/large files; decode prefix_hex to confirm format. Always emit {"answer": number}.
